---
name: dotnet-testing
description: 'Create and run automated tests for .NET applications. Use when adding features, fixing bugs, testing business rules, or preventing regressions with xUnit and Moq.'
---

# .NET Testing

1. Inspect existing test projects, test conventions, and package versions.
2. Identify success cases, invalid inputs, boundary conditions, and failure paths.
3. Write focused unit tests for business rules and application services.
4. Mock external dependencies only when appropriate.
5. Use integration tests for behavior that depends on actual framework or database integration.
6. Run the relevant tests and inspect failures.
7. Fix production code only when the evidence supports a defect; do not weaken assertions to make tests pass.
8. Report executed commands and actual results.

Never invent test results or claim unexecuted tests passed.
